create_volumetric_primitive_integrator: create a VolumetricPrimitiveRadianceFieldIntegrator with configurable max_depth, rr_depth, and kernel_type for rendering ellipsoids
build_transmission_model: build a transmission model that evaluates volumetric transmittance on intersected ellipsoid primitives using a kernel density estimate
evaluate_sh_emission: evaluate spherical harmonic directional emission on intersected volumetric primitives from SH coefficients
run_path_tracing_sample: run differentiable path tracing with Russian roulette termination and sRGB-to-linear color conversion for radiance field rendering
register_mitsuba_integrator: register a custom Mitsuba integrator plugin named volprim_rf for volumetric primitive radiance field rendering
